name: Weedle

1.name: Multiply
1.effect: Put 1 random Weedle from your deck onto your Bench.

flavour_text: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna

1.name: String Shot
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

1.name: Crushing Spear
1.effect: Discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Pinsir

1.name: Guillotine Rush
1.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

flavour_text: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Sprigatito

1.name: Cry for Help
1.effect: Put 1 random [G] Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Floragato
flavour_text: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: Meowscarada

1.name: Fighting Claws
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavour_text: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

1.name: Stoke
1.effect: Take 3 [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

name: Magmar
flavour_text: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Magmortar

1.name: Smoke Bomb
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

flavour_text: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Paldean Tauros

1.name: Blaze Tackle
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: When heated by fire energy, its horns can get hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Those gored by them will suffer both wounds and burns.

name: Tentacool
flavour_text: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.

name: Tentacruel
flavour_text: When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

name: Buizel
flavour_text: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

name: Floatzel

1.name: Water Arrow
1.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Wiglett

1.name: Spring Out
1.effect: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random. Do 30 damage to it.

flavour_text: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

1.name: Pop Out Throughout
1.effect: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random 3 times. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, do 50 damage to it.

name: Dondozo

1.name: Ocean Cyclone
1.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

name: Tatsugiri

ability.name: Retreat Directive
ability.effect: Your Active Dondozo has no Retreat Cost.

flavour_text: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

1.name: Thunderbolt
1.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Voltorb
flavour_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode

1.name: Tumbling Attack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Pachirisu

1.name: Plasma
1.effect: Take a [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched [L] Pokémon.

flavour_text: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

name: Pawmi
flavour_text: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
flavour_text: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot

ability.name: Counterattack
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Abra
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

name: Kadabra
flavour_text: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

name: Alakazam

1.name: Psychic Suppression
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any Energy attached.

flavour_text: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

name: Mr. Mime

1.name: Juggling
1.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Drifloon
flavour_text: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

name: Drifblim
flavour_text: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

ability.name: Broken-Space Bellow
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may take a [P] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

1.name: Chaotic Impact
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

name: Gimmighoul

1.name: Chest-ouflage
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

name: Machop
flavour_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke

1.name: Pummel
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp

1.name: Power Press
1.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra [F] Energy attached, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Hitmonlee
flavour_text: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

name: Hitmonchan
flavour_text: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

name: Riolu
flavour_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

1.name: Aura Sphere
1.effect: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Flamigo

1.name: Double Kick
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Ekans
flavour_text: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Arbok

1.name: Venomous Fang
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.

name: Paldean Wooper

1.name: Poison Jab
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

1.name: Venoshock
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Spiritomb

1.name: Confuse Ray
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Shroodle
flavour_text: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

name: Grafaiai

ability.name: Poison Coating
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

name: Tinkatink
flavour_text: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: Tinkatuff

1.name: Tenacious Hammer
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

1.name: Terrific Thumping
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 more damage.

name: Varoom
flavour_text: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Revavroom

1.name: Spinning Drift
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

name: Gholdengo

1.name: Scintillating Surfing
1.effect: Flip a coin for each [M] Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

name: Rattata
flavour_text: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.

name: Raticate
flavour_text: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you’ll become sleepy right away.

name: Wigglytuff

ability.name: Comforting Song
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Lickitung
flavour_text: If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you and you don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won’t go away, either.

name: Lickilicky
flavour_text: Lickilicky’s strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky’s tongue can stretch so far.

name: Bidoof
flavour_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

1.name: Carefree Press
1.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

name: Lopunny
flavour_text: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

name: Cyclizar

1.name: Overacceleration
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Overacceleration attack does +20 damage.

flavour_text: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

name: Iono
card_text: Each player shuffles the cards in their hand into their deck, then draws that many cards.

name: Pokémon Center Lady
card_text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, and it recovers from all Special Conditions.

name: Red
card_text: During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex.

card_text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
